readings.Aries: You carry momentum the way charged particles carry a field — it surrounds you, invisible, real. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Taurus: Security is not something you find. It is something you construct, slowly, from trustworthy materials. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Gemini: There is a thread you dropped three weeks ago that still leads somewhere worth going. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Cancer: Something is asking to be mourned before it can be moved past. Let it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: The person you're becoming requires a different audience than the person you were. Update accordingly. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Virgo: Not every disorder requires your intervention. Some things are allowed to be chaotic. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Libra: You are harder to read than you think. Someone in your life is misreading you right now. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Scorpio: Something is moving beneath the surface. You can feel it. Trust the feeling. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Sagittarius: Not every truth needs to be said. Ask yourself who benefits from this particular one. The first instinct was right.
readings.Capricorn: The plan is good. The plan will need adjustment. Plan for that too. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the way you've been living is about to change. You've known this for a while. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Pisces: You've been available to everyone. Today, be unavailable to everyone except yourself. Let this one be easy.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
